_template_notes: Literary or contemporary fiction with near-empty canon — no magic system, no invented world, no franchise to hew to. The 'canon' is essentially real-world plausibility and the book's own internal character/plot facts. canon_expert's main job is narrative consistency rather than lore enforcement. Keep cross_continuity_violations and anachronistic_terms empty; keep meta_reference_rules to just the style discipline rules.
continuity_description: Contemporary/literary fiction. The story's world is the real world (or close to it); no invented lore applies. Canon enforcement is narrative consistency: characters' established biography, relationships, and stated facts must hold across the book.
